1. (Currently amended) A humeral implant comprising a first __humeral surface component__ removably attached to a second component, __wherein the first humeral surface component has a concave undersurface__.

2. (Currently amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral __surface component__ and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral __surface component__ has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature, __and a concave undersurface for bony ingrowth material__.

9. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface is spherically or elliptically shaped.

12. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface for bony ingrowth material.

13. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral __surface component__ has a smooth articulating surface.

(Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has [[a variable length wherein said stem has a variable length wherein]] __one of a plurality of different lengths, each length being selected such that the stem extends__ from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral __surface component__ connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral __surface component__ connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper[[, and a screw]] __and a screw__.

27. (Currently amended) A __glenohumeral joint implant comprising__ an implant __adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint to provide__ a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus.

28. (Currently amended) The __glenohumeral joint implant__ of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant.

29. (Currently amended) A __humerus bone implant comprising__ a modular implant with a humeral surface and a stem, wherein said stem is __adapted to be__ anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of said humerus bone.

30. (Previously presented) The repaired humerus bone of claim 29 wherein said stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

31. (Previously presented) The repaired humerus bone of claim 30 wherein said stem is linear.
